# Representation Is Not Ontology

The success of a holographic representation does not by itself establish that the lower-dimensional QFT is what the cosmos fundamentally is. It establishes that, within a controlled duality, one mathematical presentation calculates observables of another; ontology requires an additional claim about which structures are fundamental, derivative, or merely equivalent descriptions.

## Three claims

Keep separate:

1. **Computational representation:** continued QFT correlators calculate cosmological correlators.
2. **Dual equivalence:** two complete descriptions encode the same physical content in a declared domain.
3. **Ontological reduction:** one side is more fundamental and the other emerges from it.

The first can be established without the third. Even a strong dual equivalence can underdetermine ontological priority.

In holographic cosmology, the operational pseudo-QFT is obtained by calculating in a domain-wall QFT and continuing its parameters. This is a powerful spectral representation. It does not by itself identify a codimension-two causal cut with a three-dimensional Euclidean QFT, nor does it show that a Lorentzian cosmological history is literally generated by Euclidean RG flow.

## Wavefunctions sharpen the distinction

[[library/operator-dictionaries-and-wave-functions-in-ads-cft-and-ds-cft/inq|Harlow and Stanford]] show why analytic continuation at wavefunction level does not collapse the different operator and expectation-value dictionaries. In cosmology one uses \(|\Psi|^2\) and integrates over boundary data; in an AdS or domain-wall calculation the gluing and observable prescription differ. Equality of one continued coefficient is therefore weaker than identity of the complete theories.

## Use inside the broader programme

For the causal-scale programme, the clean order is

$$
\text{causal-scale state}
\longrightarrow
\text{positive physical correlation functional}
\longrightarrow
\begin{cases}
\text{holographic QFT representation},\\
\text{geometric filling representation},\\
\text{another microscopic realization}.
\end{cases}
$$

This order makes holographic cosmology valuable without making it load-bearing for the ontology of the wall. If a particular CWST member claims a genuine duality, it must supply the Lorentzian observer/cut object, the Euclidean QFT, the map between them, the state and continuation, and the domain in which the equivalence holds.
